notes.title: STEAM PAGE LIVE!
notes.content:
After many years of solo-development I am very proud to finally have the Steam page for Bombard go live.

I cant tell you how momentous this is for me. I have been developing BOMBARD! in my spare time for years now, evenings and weekends around my day job and the game is very close to Demo rrelease with a full release in the not-too-distant future.

I will be sharing progress here regularly. Discord to be up soon.
